status: Requested follow-up fixes implemented and verified locally; no publication or package rename.

DataTable: Table expands to its actual container; sticky column offsets track distributed widths.
Mobile sort, filter and select-all remain visible; utility headers stack correctly.
Aligned headers, numeric values, groups and complete row actions; default action column is now 120px.
Reset restores density and details; prototype-sensitive filter and column keys handled safely.
AnimatedBorder: Host, overlay, mask and light trajectory now use the same precise border-box coordinates.
Fractional dimensions, asymmetric borders, elliptical/percentage radii, resize, scrolling and transforms covered.
External neon halo retained; host is not clipped to conceal the defect.
documentation: NEO UI spelling across site title and branding.
Stable IconButton controls and locale menu replace jumping text segments.
Named xs/sm/md/lg size selectors; genuine numeric parameters use NumberField.
Icon and Loader accept named sizes while existing numeric/CSS values remain valid.
related: RotaryKnob fits a 200px container and stays aligned during rotation without clipping focus or glow.
Badge text contrast corrected across four palettes and two schemes; offline StatusIndicator CSS scoped to its own component.

verification.testFirst: Dedicated red evidence retained for fixes; green and related suites passed.

lazyImports.decision: Keep public component exports synchronous and tree-shakeable. Defer pages and heavy optional editors; existing documentation already loads examples and editor tooling lazily.

limitations: No claim of universal visual perfection or legal naming clearance.
This follow-up used installed Chrome/Edge on the available desktop; physical low-end/mobile devices, Safari/Firefox and screen readers remain unverified.
Full 100-page axe audit and animation CPU comparison belong to the previous pass; follow-up rechecked changed pages and geometry independently.
